content.title: 2025 Native American Apache Tribe 6-pc Set BU | GOVMINT
content.text: Paying Tribute To Apache Culture And History The Native American coin sets honoring different tribes continues with the 2025 Apache Tribe Set. Known for their fierce independence and warrior culture, the Apache Indians are a group of Native American tribes originally from the southwestern United States, including areas of present-day Arizona, New Mexico, Texas, and parts of northern Mexico. Traditionally, the Apache lived in diverse environments, from the mountainous regions to the desert plains, which influenced their way of life. Legal-Tender Native American Coins Long before America was a nation of states, it was a nation of tribes. To honor these tribes, a series of Indian Sovereign Nations coins have been authorized by each tribe. The coins are also recognized by the Federal Government as legal tender in each tribal nation as set forth in the Constitution of the United States and from the terms of bilateral treaties that date back to the 18th century. One-Year-Only Designs Honor Apache Culture The Apache Tribe Six-Piece Set features six different obverse designs depicting images important to Apache culture, tradition, and history. The designs include a portrait of Geronimo a renowned Apache war chief and medicine man known for his fierce resistance against U.S. and Mexican forces during the Apache Wars. Other designs include a coyote and prairie dogs. The coyote was a significant figure in Apache culture associated with both positive and negative traits like cunning, mischief, and even wisdom, playing a key role in creation myths and often linked to hunting and warfare. Prairie dogs were a significant food source, especially before the introduction of horses into the Apache culture. The Apache were nomadic and built temporary dwellings called wickiups made of brush, wood, and grass. They hunted bison, deer, and other game, and gathered wild plants, nuts, and berries. They were also skilled at fishing and gathering edible plants, such as mesquite beans and wild onions. In times of drought or scarcity, they relied on a diet of corn, beans, and squash, which they cultivated. The Apache people developed a deep connection to the land and maintained a strong sense of community through storytelling, music, and traditional ceremonies. Beautifully Displayed In Colorful Blister Pack Every coin in this 2025 Native American Apache Tribe Six-Piece Set is official Indian Sovereign Nations legal tender. The denominations include one-cent, five-cent, 10-cent, 25-cent, 50-cent, and $1 coin. Each coin comes in original Brilliant Uncirculated (BU) condition, and the entire set comes packaged in a blister pack that displays both the front and back of all six coins. Secure yours today! COIN HIGHLIGHTS: ONE-YEAR-ONLY DESIGNS HONOR APACHE NATION – The set pays tribute to the rich legacy of the Apache Nation. Each coin in the set features a shared reverse, while the one-year-only obverse designs depict items, animals, and people central to the Apache way of life. LEGAL TENDER COINS – These coins were struck in the United States and are Indian Sovereign Nations legal tender under the terms of a bilateral treaties made in the 18th Century with the Federal Government. The denominations include 1₵, 5₵, 10₵, 25₵, 50₵ and $1 Cupronickel (CuNi) coins. BRILLIANT UNCIRCULATED CONDITION – Each coin in your 2025 Native American Apache Tribe Six-Piece Set comes in original Brilliant Uncirculated (BU) condition as fresh and crisp as the day they left the mint. ORIGINAL MINT PACKAGING – The complete six-piece set comes displayed in is original blister pack, which also serves as the set’s certificate of authenticity.
